name: Back Pain
shortDescription: Targeted spinal rehabilitation, manual mobilization, and core stabilization to resolve acute and chronic lower back pain.
description: Lower back pain is one of the most common musculoskeletal complaints in Calgary. Whether caused by disc herniation, facet joint irritation, ligament sprains, or prolonged postural strain, our physiotherapists use advanced orthopaedic manual therapy and functional core retraining to eliminate pain and restore full spinal mobility.
symptoms: Dull, persistent ache or sharp pinching in the lumbar spine
Stiffness when getting out of bed or rising from a chair
Spasms in the paraspinal and gluteal muscles
Difficulty bending forward, lifting, or standing for long periods
treatmentApproach: Comprehensive Biomechanical Assessment: In-depth lumbar spine, pelvic alignment, and posture evaluation.
CAMPT-Certified Manual Therapy: Hands-on spinal joint mobilizations and gentle manual therapy for rapid relief.
Deep Muscle Release: IMS / Dry Needling to release chronic deep lumbar muscle spasms and trigger points.
Targeted Core Stabilization: Custom active stabilization exercises based on McKenzie and Stuart McGill protocols.

name: SI Joint Dysfunction
shortDescription: Targeted pelvic alignment, sacroiliac joint stabilization, and manual therapy for sharp buttock and hip pain.
description: Sacroiliac (SI) joint dysfunction occurs when the joint connecting your sacrum and pelvic bone becomes hypermobile, locked, or inflamed. It often mimics sciatica or disc herniation with sharp, localized pain in one buttock. Our physical therapists realign the pelvis and restore joint stability.
benefits: Restores anatomical pelvic and sacroiliac joint alignment
Stabilizes the pelvic girdle with targeted muscular retraining
Relieves sharp buttock and groin pain when walking or rolling over
symptoms: Sharp, stabbing pain in one buttock or the back of the hip
Discomfort when bearing weight on one leg or climbing stairs
Pain when rolling over in bed or getting out of a car
Aching that radiates into the groin or back of the upper thigh
treatmentApproach: Sacroiliac Alignment: Manual pelvic correction and gentle sacroiliac joint realignment.
Deep Stabilizer Strengthening: Targeted exercises for the gluteus medius and deep pelvic stabilizer muscles.
Stability Support: Sacroiliac belt bracing recommendations for acute ligamentous instability.
Targeted Soft Tissue Release: Myofascial release and dry needling of piriformis and hypertonic gluteal muscles.

name: Neck & Shoulder Pain
shortDescription: Relief from cervical stiffness, pinched nerves, posture fatigue, and radiating shoulder tension.
description: Neck and shoulder pain often stem from cervical joint restrictions, poor desk ergonomics ('tech neck'), or whiplash. When the cervical spine loses natural mobility, compensatory strain builds up across the upper trapezius and levator scapulae muscles, causing chronic aching and restricted rotation.
symptoms: Stiffness turning the head or checking blind spots while driving
Radiating tension from the neck down into the shoulder blades
Tension headaches originating at the base of the skull (cervicogenic headaches)
Numbness or tingling sensations into the shoulder or arm
treatmentApproach: Cervical Joint Mobilization: Gentle cervical and upper thoracic joint mobilizations to restore freedom of motion.
Myofascial Decompression: Focused soft tissue release of suboccipital, levator scapulae, and shoulder girdle muscles.
Deep Flexor Retraining: Cervical deep flexor coordination and chin-tuck exercises to support the cervical spine.
Ergonomic Calibration: Workplace and lifestyle postural calibration to eliminate daily repetitive strain.

treatmentApproach: Neurological Diagnostics: Sensory, motor, reflex, and nerve root tension testing to pinpoint compression.
Neural Mobilization: Gentle nerve flossing techniques to relieve nerve root adherence and restore mobility.
Directional Preference Exercises: Lumbar directional preference movements to centralize and eliminate radiating pain.
Deep Gluteal Decompression: Piriformis and deep gluteal myofascial release to relieve sciatic nerve pressure.
